svg.title: From timed trajectories to the ActionNode schedule
svg.desc: CHUGG returns per-entity trajectories; ResponseFromTrajectories turns every non-wait motion into an ActionNode, builds an action DAG, and serialises it with integer parent indices.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
